name: preview-card-1x
title: Preview Card 1x: Notch label
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The name sits in a notch cut into the preview’s bottom-left corner. There’s no separate footer.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
